Name: Slow's Forest Farm
Author: slowmoth
Description:
Hello are you like me and had a crisis when planning out the forest farm? Well then this map edit might be for you!

I edited the forest farm to:
- allow grass to grow on certain grassy tiles
- make grandpa's shrine less hidden
- erase the lake in the middle and the one at the bottom

Downloads.Description: Edit of the standard Forest Farm to have more tillable space and allow grass to spread on certain grassy tiles.
